purpose: Audit whether published CMM validation can distinguish a recovered message from inputs generated without a message.
prior_exposure: README claims and static code inspected before this protocol
Existing public tables have been inspected for schema and folio availability only; no new metric execution
Analytic metric identity and likely negative result predicted before execution

execution.core: Execute original source after replacing its sole invalid UTF-8 byte 0x92 in a comment with ASCII apostrophe in memory only.
execution.environment: Temporary working directory, MPL Agg, no network, no BERT, no full CLI or plots.

uniform_eva.generation: Independent uniform characters; lengths uniform integers; no plaintext supplied

unit_draws.generation: Independent uniform choice of units; no plaintext supplied
unit_draws.limitation: Targeted null reusing mapped word inventory, not claimed to model the historical manuscript

periodic_adversarial.limitation: Adversarial periodic counterexample suggested by static independent code audit, not a realistic historical null or random input.

archived_results.metric_recompute: direct lexicon membership on archived Latin
archived_results.limitation: Published CSV is an aggregate of parallel transcriptions, not a canonical independent manuscript corpus.

primary_checks: Output vocabulary from all context maps is included in MED_LEX
Every nonempty generated result obeys 1-C/N identity
Save every control input, clauses, rendered output and metrics; no selection by score
Count lexicon_alignment>=0.91, z_score>=18.4 and z_score>30 as descriptive benchmarks of README claims, not inferential p-values

secondary_diagnostics.semantic_relabel: For first sample in each family, cyclically permute MED_LEX token names; check all compute_metrics fields invariant. No new decoder or claimed alternate translation.
secondary_diagnostics.sensitivity_zero: Use a repeated 100 times and drop_ratio=0; published code still permutes one mapping to itself. Record raw-token and processed-token entropy plus returned sensitivity.
secondary_diagnostics.encoding: Record exact raw bytes, SHA and one-comment adaptation.

decision: A high lexical score on message-free inputs, or proof that the score is entailed by output construction, disqualifies that score as evidence of translation. This does not decide whether Voynich has a message or reject every possible Latin hypothesis.
scope: One public implementation and its archived artifacts. No claim of historical authorship, intent or complete replication of unprovided external research.
